question.en: Who focuses, by what method, and when?
question.zh-cn: 谁来对焦？用什么方法？何时更新？

summary.en: Distinguish focus operation, detection method and behavior over time.
summary.zh-cn: 区分操作方式、检测原理与持续工作的模式。

boundary.en: Manual/auto, phase/contrast and single/continuous AF answer separate questions. Depth of field is not an AF mode.
boundary.zh-cn: 手动或自动、相位或反差、单次或连续分别回答不同问题，景深不是自动对焦模式。
